an7.10:2.1: dve piyāni → dvepiyañca (sya-all) | piyāni → piyaṁ dve (pts) | dve → M7. S. piyañ ca. (pts note) | dhanaṁ → M. Ph. M8 have for this Pāda: dve pi dhammā (Ph. M8 dhamme) balaṁ (M8 bale) dhanaṁ. (pts note)
an7.10:2.2: vitthataṁ → only in S.; T. M6. M7 have apaṁñā ve. (pts note)
an7.10:2.3: uggaṁ saṁyojanañceva pahānaṁ macchariyena → uggasaññojanañceva pahānamacchariyena (sya-all)
an7.10:2.4:
macchariyenacā’ti → dve piyadve bala dhanaṁ asaññī me saṅkhittañceva vitthataṁ. 
uggasaññojanaṁ ceva pahānamacchariyena cā’ti – sīmu (bj note) | macchariyenā → M. Ph. T. -yena cā; M8 -yena ca (without ti). (pts note)
